metadata.title: Secure Network Gateway SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing Secure Network Gateways that mediate, enforce, and monitor network traffic at trust boundaries, including ingress, egress, and inter-zone gateways.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, and resiliency baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional network gateway capability enforcing identity-aware, policy-driven control of network traffic across trust boundaries.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Secure Network Gateway inherits governance and assurance from the Secure Network Platform SSPP.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Gateway enforcement relies on Secure Identity Providers for identity assertions and authentication context.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Gateway decisions consume identity assurance signals evaluated by the Secure Identity Assurance SSPP.

props.name: implements-pattern
props.remarks: Gateway functions as a primary Policy Enforcement Point (PEP) for network traffic.

props.name: implements-pattern
props.remarks: Gateway enforces explicit outbound connectivity and destination controls.

props.name: implements-pattern
props.remarks: Gateway generates telemetry and supports automated response actions.

props.name: gateway-role
props.remarks: Secure Network Gateways may operate at ingress, egress, or inter-zone boundaries.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network gateways enforce Zero Trust Architecture principles through explicit policy evaluation and enforcement.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Gateway enforcement aligns with Zero Trust Networking guidance, mediating identity-aware ingress, lateral, and egress traffic.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Gateway placement and policy enforcement support containment and reduction of blast radius during incidents.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure Network Gateways provide mediated enforcement of network policy decisions, generate security telemetry, and execute response actions. They do not define policy logic or identity proofing, which are handled by dependent SSPPs.

components.title: Network Ingress Gateway
components.description: Mediates inbound traffic entering institutional trust zones.

components.title: Network Egress Gateway
components.description: Enforces outbound traffic policy and destination constraints.

components.title: Inter-Zone Gateway
components.description: Controls and monitors traffic moving between internal network zones.

roles.title: Network Gateway Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Defines gateway placement, trust boundaries, and enforcement responsibilities.

roles.title: Network Gateway Operations
roles.remarks: Operates gateway infrastructure and ensures continuous enforcement.

roles.title: Network Gateway Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors gateway telemetry and coordinates incident response.

control-implementation.remarks: Security controls for gateways are implemented through inherited Secure Network patterns and platform controls. This SSPP documents enforcement scope and assurance, not control design.
